{{Quote|Prefect Wann, do come in and bring your datapad with you. Prefect, what time is the merchant Ulicx due to lift off from Dentani Starport?|Governor Desh, to Wann|<ref name="SL" />}}
'''Wann''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Imperial Prefect]] who served as the assistant of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Desh (Imperial)|Desh]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After Desh lost a large amounts of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Ulicx Vinaq]] while [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]], Desh summoned Wann to his office and ordered the Prefect to post a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Vinaq once the Devaronian had taken off from [[Dentani Starport]].
